long_biography.plain_text:
In 2013, Media Ventures exchanged several online-marketing companies for newly issued Ströer shares. The deal moved Ströer Digital Media and businessAD into the listed group, connecting Dirk Ströer’s independently assembled internet portfolio with the company inherited from his father.

His entrepreneurial path began in municipal sign advertising through City Design, followed by work establishing the family group’s Polish operation. He then launched orangemedia and neu.de and used them as the basis for a broader investment company. Alongside that activity, Ströer spent years overseeing the listed company as a supervisory director until 2021. Today he sets strategy at Media Ventures and holds 20.22% of Ströer under a voting pool with Udo Müller.
